run_coco_eval: run the coco evaluation script with --pred_file and --annotation_file to evaluate image caption predictions
run_print_metrics: run the print_metrics function to display Bleu, METEOR, ROUGE_L, SPICE, and CIDEr scores
test_coco_eval_cli: test the coco_eval CLI by passing a prediction JSON file and a numpy annotation file
review_print_metrics: review the print_metrics function that formats and prints COCO caption evaluation metrics as percentages
summarize_coco_eval_main: summarize the main block that loads predictions and ground truth captions then calculates COCO metrics
